changes: Owned lockstep native binding; removed steady-state phase counters and periodic tracing, retaining stall watchdog and failure reports; BF16 sums fold global ranks in canonical order in both vector lanes and scalar tails Optional same-stream rank-packet exchange defers reduction to the immediate MHC consumer. A replay-time TX reservation accepts direct W4 output; publication waits for all producer writers, preserves collective tickets, and hands canonical rank pointers to MHC. Small integer gather uses one CTA on the same publication ring and preserves candidate bits in canonical rank order inside bounded CUDA graphs. Host proxy health uses a proxy-published monotonic timestamp and explicit thread-exit status; rapid capture polls stay healthy and idle callers cannot renew the two-second stale deadline.
